pages.text: Hollis sent you? Ha! He sends everyone. Fine. Sit tight, I'll make it quick. The sea doesn't wait, and neither does the tide.
See the corner of your screen? That's your &6minimap&r. You're the arrow, other players are faces, and every NPC is on it. Press &6=&r and &6-&r to zoom. Underground it switches to a cave view.

Press &6M&r for the &6world map&r. It remembers everywhere you've walked. Drag to move, scroll to zoom, &6C&r to centre on yourself. &6Right-click&r anywhere to drop a waypoint with a name and colour.

A waypoint you &6track&r gets a diamond in the world and a compass ribbon at the top of your screen. The Journal's Track button uses the same trick. Never leave town without a compass, I say. Or a sandwich.
